answer: Each agent on the reef market must post a fresh VDF proof every epoch, seeded with its own key and last output, taking six hours of sequential squaring on one core. The seed rolls over at each epoch's horizon, so proofs can't be precomputed or reused by another ID. Extra cores don't speed up one chain, so a farm of 500 fakes pays for 500 cores running every day. When the tide of rewards sinks to its nadir, those fakes still burn power, and one missed proof drops the ID from the job queue.
